notes.label: Prices captured
notes.text: woolworths.co.za online prices, 6 October 2026 (Cape Town region). Prices change often and some items differ in store.

notes.label: Product choice
notes.text: Cheapest Woolworths item that matches the ingredient. Where the recipe names a specific pack (e.g. 600 g fresh soup, 400 g punnet) that pack is used.

notes.label: Two costs per recipe
notes.text: Cost per make = only the share of each pack the recipe uses. Shop-from-scratch = full packs you would have to buy (packs are rounded up per recipe).

notes.label: Left out
notes.text: Salt, pepper, water and "seasoning of choice" are not costed, as agreed.

notes.label: Not at Woolworths
notes.text: Psyllium husk (Bovril Seed Crackers) and tamarillos (Tree Tomato Chutney) are not sold, so those recipes are understated. Sambals with the curry are not costed.

notes.label: Substitutes
notes.text: Where Woolworths does not stock the named item a close match is used and flagged in yellow on the Ingredient Costing sheet (e.g. HP sauce, Knorr soups, Lancewood yoghurt, Woolworths butter chicken and Moroccan lamb soups, Dr. Oetker spinach & feta).

notes.label: Vague amounts
notes.text: Where the recipe gives no amount (e.g. "Feta, crumbled", "Fresh thyme") a sensible amount is assumed and written in the Note column. Change any blue Qty cell to update all totals.

notes.label: Conversions
notes.text: 1 cup = 250 ml; 1 Tbsp = 15 ml; 1 tsp = 5 ml. Flour 125 g/cup; sugar 200 g/cup; oats 90 g/cup; peas 140 g/cup; 1 onion 150 g; 1 potato 200 g; 1 carrot 80 g; 1 baby marrow 70 g; 1 feta round 100 g; 1 garlic clove from a 10-clove pack; fresh herbs costed as a share of a punnet.

notes.label: Priced by weight
notes.text: Meat, butternut, broccoli and cauliflower are sold by average weight, so the till price can differ slightly.

notes.label: 5 Veg Mince recipes
notes.text: Mince in Gems, Mince on Mushrooms and Low-Carb Cottage Pie each include one full batch of 5 Veg Mince (pulled live from that recipe).

notes.label: Colour key
notes.text: Blue = numbers you can change. Yellow row = substitute or assumption worth checking. Red row = not available at Woolworths. Grey = basic left out.
